arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Bolter argued Section 1367 solves procedural problems.
Mr. Rotenberg emphasized the federalism issue in the case.
Mr. Clement argued the statute excludes nonconsenting states.
The Chief Justice noted the case was submitted.
